core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sawda (سودة) is a feminine personal name derived from the Arabic colour term aswad (“black”), with the feminine ending. It is best known as the name of Sawda bint Zam'a, whom the Prophet Muhammad married after Khadija's death. The name is pre-Islamic in use and is not a Qur'anic term.
